ExitMultipleTerms.description:
The terms of `tv.exit_multiple` inside `tv.compare`: the rate and the growth cap are shared
and used when `next_flow` is given.

metric.description:
`ebitda`, `ebit`, `revenue` (enterprise basis) or `earnings` (equity basis); must match
the basis of the comparison.

metric_value.description: The metric at N, in currency units, greater than 0.

next_flow.description:
Flow at N + 1, in currency units. Optional: when given, the implied growth is computed
at the shared rate.

GordonTerms.description: The terms of `tv.gordon` inside `tv.compare`: the rate and the growth cap are shared.

growth.description: Perpetual growth of the flow, decimal fraction per period, below the shared rate.

last_flow.description: Flow at N, in currency units, grown by `growth`. Give this or `next_flow`, not both.

next_flow.description: Flow at N + 1, in currency units. Give this or `last_flow`, not both.

HModelTerms.description: The terms of `tv.h_model` inside `tv.compare`: the rate and the growth cap are shared.

half_life.description: H, in periods, zero or positive.

long_term_growth.description: g_l, decimal fraction per period, below the shared rate.

LimitedHorizonTerms.description:
The terms of `tv.limited_horizon` inside `tv.compare`: the rate and the growth cap are
shared.

flow.description: First flow, at the end of period N + 1, in currency units.

growth.description: Growth of the flow per period, decimal fraction. Default: 0.

periods.description: Number of further periods n, from 1 to 10000.

residual_value.description: Residual value at N + n, in currency units. Default: 0.

Line.description: A labelled amount, for example an asset and its realisable value.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "Land" or "Bank loan". Not empty.

value.description: Amount in currency units, zero or positive.

assets.description: Assets with their realisable values at N, in currency units, each zero or positive.

liabilities.description: Liabilities settled at N, in currency units, each zero or positive.

liquidation_costs.description:
Costs of the liquidation (legal fees, closure, severance), in currency units, each zero
or positive.

tax_on_gains.description: Tax on the gains realised, as an amount in currency units, zero or positive.

MultipleMetric.description:
The metric a multiple applies to. Enterprise multiples (EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales) give
an enterprise value; P/E gives an equity value. The two are never mixed.

oneOf.description: EBITDA at N; multiple EV/EBITDA, enterprise basis.
EBIT at N; multiple EV/EBIT, enterprise basis.
Revenue at N; multiple EV/Sales, enterprise basis.
Net earnings at N; multiple P/E, equity basis.

NormalisedIncomeTerms.description:
The terms of `tv.normalised_income` inside `tv.compare`: the growth cap is shared; the
capitalisation rate stays a term of the technique.

capitalisation_rate.description: Capitalisation rate i, decimal fraction per period.

growth.description: Perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none (R / i).

income.description: Normalised income R, in currency units.

Technique.description:
One technique to compare, named by its method id, with its own terms. The shared rate and
growth cap are not repeated here.

oneOf.description: Exit multiple on the basis of the comparison; `next_flow` optional.
Normalised income with its own capitalisation rate.
Liquidation: the analyst lists the liabilities of the declared basis.

TerminalBasis.description: Whether a terminal value is a value of the whole business or of its equity.

oneOf.description:
Enterprise value: flows to all capital providers (FCFF), discounted at the WACC;
multiples EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales.

Equity value: flows to shareholders (FCFE, dividends), discounted at the cost of
equity; multiple P/E.

ValueDriverTerms.description: The terms of `tv.value_driver` inside `tv.compare`: the rate and the growth cap are shared.

growth.description: Perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period, below the shared rate.

ronic.description: Return on new invested capital, decimal fraction per period, greater than 0.

basis.description:
`enterprise` or `equity`: the basis of every terminal value compared. An exit multiple
of the other basis is refused.

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period, shared by every
growth-based technique. Default: none, reported as absent.

rate.description:
Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period, shared by every
technique that uses a discount rate.

techniques.description:
Techniques to run, at least one, each written `{"tv.<name>": {terms}}`; the same
technique may appear more than once.
